Why the receiver is the hard part
3,640×
weaker at 1 m than at 30 cm

A 10 cm × 20 cm metal target returns 1,456 nT at 30 cm and 0.4 nT at 1 m. Low-noise instrumentation amps and 18-bit SAR ADCs are chosen for that floor.

Ansys Maxwell 3D · field at the receiver from eddy currents in the target · log scaletri-axial magnetometers cover ferrous targets < 30 cm
Architecture

Timed by an FPGA. Run by a Pi.

Hybrid H-bridge with an active linear stage and analog PI loop holds current symmetric in any soil · TI UCC27714 600 V driver, 4 A sink

Built for metal in wet, conductive ground.
